# lib/encoder module

Interrupt-driven x4 quadrature decoder for 8-bit PICs. This page is the reference for the `lib/encoder` HAL module, for firmware authors choosing and wiring it in.

## Use it

The manifest lists one example program per family, plus peer programs for extra transports where the driver has them. Build one with the repository build driver (--example names a peer), or read it as the working starting point for your own firmware.

| Family | Example | Source |
|---|---|---|
| PIC16F87XA | `encoder` | [`lib/encoder/examples/example_encoder.c`](https://github.com/apojomovsky/epic-hal/blob/master/lib/encoder/examples/example_encoder.c) |
| PIC16F88X | `encoder` | [`lib/encoder/examples/example_encoder.c`](https://github.com/apojomovsky/epic-hal/blob/master/lib/encoder/examples/example_encoder.c) |
| PIC18Fxx5x | `encoder` | [`lib/encoder/examples/example_encoder.c`](https://github.com/apojomovsky/epic-hal/blob/master/lib/encoder/examples/example_encoder.c) |

## API

The API is documented next to the code, in the [`lib/encoder` directory](https://github.com/apojomovsky/epic-hal/tree/master/lib/encoder). This page does not restate it. The manifest carries no function list, so no API table is generated here yet.

## Limits

- Not built for PIC18F2455, PIC18F2550. Reason: RAM: does not fit on this smaller part.
- Not built for PIC16F870, PIC16F871, PIC16F872. Reason: RAM: module state does not fit.
